name: Yaguchi-No-Watashi
tagline: Shinagawa in 23 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Tamagawa Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 43 minutes to Otemachi, 44 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 4.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 4.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.8 m to 4.9 m, a difference of 1.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 4 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 4 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 栄慈会岩崎内科病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 静恒会本多病院, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Tamagawa Line.
congestion: Tokyu Tamagawa Line runs at 112% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 矢口渡→蒲田, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: For the number of medical facilities, Hasunuma; for how close the centre is, Yaguchi-No-Watashi.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Yaguchi-No-Watashi. Hasunuma has the Tokyu Ikegami Line, a different set from Yaguchi-No-Watashi. To Shibuya, for instance, Hasunuma takes 4 minutes longer. On what it offers families, Yaguchi-No-Watashi comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Yaguchi-No-Watashi is ahead on how close the centre is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Yaguchi-No-Watashi. It is served by the same lines as Yaguchi-No-Watashi. To Shinagawa, for instance, Musashi-Nitta takes 3 minutes longer. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

noiseSources: 環八通り (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 7 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Tamagawa Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
